an4.169:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo diṭṭh' eva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:1.4: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:1.5: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo diṭṭh' eva dhamme asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:1.6: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti. 2.
an4.169:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo diṭṭh' eva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
an4.169:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī
an4.169:2.3: maraṇasaññā kho pan' assa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
an4.169:2.4: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati--saddhābalaṃ . . .
an4.169:2.8: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā diṭṭh' eva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti. 3.
an4.169:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
an4.169:3.2: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī viharati . . .
an4.169:3.3: maraṇasaññā kho pan' assa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
an4.169:3.4: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati--
an4.169:3.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti. 4.
an4.169:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo diṭṭh' eva dhamme asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
an4.169:4.2: Idha bhikkhave vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.169:4.7: adhimattattā diṭṭh' eva dhamme asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an4.169:4.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave ekacco puggalo diṭṭh' eva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyi hoti. 5.
an4.169:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
an4.169:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.169:5.8: kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin
